digest.component_or_area: bridge runner and destructive-repair pause ownership
propositions: The bridge runner must execute identically across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single packaged Python entrypoint
Legacy reconcile callers using rebar reconcile --mode retain their behavior, published defaults, and exit codes without modification
Destructive-repair pause ownership is provider-neutral and uses git refs/reconciler/gate durable coordination without GitHub CLI dependency
The runner-neutral bridge entrypoint and provider-specific thin wrappers execute through exactly rebar bridge run with no repository-local runner script required
Destructive repair safety is owned by _repair_pause.py which reads pause snapshots, calls set_pause, and releases only its observed OID through the durable gate lifecycle
Checked-out workflows and environments using legacy reconcile vocabulary continue to operate without breaking changes
